content:
jordan: Quick sync on the onboarding first-run — I prototyped a little guided tour and a persistent quickstart card. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/efgh5678/onboard-ux-v2

maria: Saw it. The card feels lighter than a modal but might get lost on small screens. Thoughts on auto-hiding after first complete?

priya: Auto-hide ok but must be dismissible and accessible. Use `aria-expanded` + `aria-controls` on the card so screen readers understand the reveal.

leo: If we do guided tour, keep steps <=4 and show progress. No one reads long onboarding. Also consider a skip link in top-right of the tour with `aria-label="Skip tour"`.

samir: Accessibility note: the cyan CTA has low contrast on the light bg, 3.6:1. Need >=4.5:1 for body text or bump font weight. Also ensure focus outline is visible for keyboard users.

jordan: Good call. I'm leaning to a hybrid: quickstart card (non-blocking) that opens a compact guided modal when clicked. Card has 3 quick links: Connect key, Run demo, Explore samples.

maria: Love hybrid. For sample apps, can we add tiny live examples that run in-browser (no key) for `assistant-chat` and `summarize`? We can clearly label them "demo mode".

priya: Demo mode must warn about limits and not show real usage-based billing. Add a tooltip on demo label explaining "sandboxed, no billing". Use `role="tooltip"` and keyboard focusable `i` icon.

leo: UX microcopy: instead of "Connect API key" maybe use "Link your API key" — shorter and friendlier. Also test `Get demo running` vs `Run demo` CTAs.

samir: Also propose an accessibility mode toggle (small switch) in the tour settings: larger fonts, stronger focus styles, reduced motion. Accessible users can opt in and we persist via account prefs.

jordan: Telemetry: fire `onboard.card_shown`, `onboard.card_clicked`, `onboard.tour_started`, `onboard.tour_step_completed`, `onboard.opt_out`. Product to add to tracking plan.

maria: Mobile behavior: at <=420px the card becomes a stacked mini-banner under header, not overlaying content. We'll test on 360px and 412px.

priya: Keyboard nav tests: tab order should go card CTA -> skip -> help link. We'll add storybook stories and a11y tests (axe).

leo: For the guided modal steps: 1) Link API key, 2) Choose sample app, 3) Run one-shot demo, 4) Save route. Keep buttons `Next`/`Back` with clear labels.

samir: Copy variants to A/B: A) "Get started — build a demo in minutes" B) "Quickstart — your first inference". Recommend A but test.

jordan: Small dev ask: can sample apps include a `manifest.json` + `seed_prompt.txt` so deploy button works? We should keep demos <100KB.

maria: I'll coordinate user sessions next Thurs. Can we have an interactive prototype with both card+modal by Wed?

onboarding-bot: Reminder: research session scheduled Thu 2:00pm. Recording will be uploaded to #research.

priya: I'll PR the aria-live regions and focus ring updates by Tue. Also adding alt text requirements for sample screenshots.

jordan: Action items: Leo to prepare microcopy variants and sample manifests; Priya to implement a11y fixes; Maria to set up prototype and research; Samir to define accessibility toggle spec; Product to update telemetry.

maria: Thanks all. If we can get the prototype ready early, we can recruit 6 participants instead of 4.

jordan: Great — closing thread unless new blockers. :thumbsup:
